title: A decided owed batch bind that never reached Engram is told "may or may not be bound" instead of "not sent"
outcome: An owed batch bind records whether a verification_bind send was actually attempted, for example a flag set when its send is claimed. Give-up and reset wording then uses that flag. A decision stored and confirmed but never transmitted (attempts consumed by "the session has no routing token yet", or sends skipped before the call) is told "not recorded / not sent". Only one that may have reached Engram is told "unconfirmed; it may or may not be bound". Today engram_owed_bind_may_be_bound treats every confirmed decision as possibly sent, which is safe but sends the holder to check a run needlessly.
acceptance: A decided owed batch bind that never reached Engram is told "may or may not be bound" instead of "not sent" is done
